messages:
ashwin: Heads up — EU warm pool GPU nodes are failing to join after the FW policy cutover in eu-west-1. Provisioning shows repeated egress timeouts and a spike in auditshipper errors. Affected capacity ~120 GPUs :frowning:

lina: Saw this too, repro steps: new fw rule `deny-172.31.0.0/16:egress` applied to provisioner SGs. Nodes get to `waiting-for-egress` then time out on KMS grants and image pull checks. NATGW QPS is high.

ashwin: Logs snippet from one node:

```
2024-04-05T09:12:03Z WARN provisioning egress-blocked: connect to auditshipper.redwood:443 -> TLS handshake failed
2024-04-05T09:12:11Z ERROR kms grant fetch failed: 403 forbidden
2024-04-05T09:12:29Z INFO warm-pool: join attempt 7/10
```

deploy-bot: firewall-rollout v2.3 deployed to eu-west-1 by infra-team @infra on 2024-04-05T09:08Z :white_check_mark:

maria: Is this the same rollout that added the new L7 inspection rules? If so, the auditshipper endpoint lives on a private endpoint that needs nat access. We can either allowlist that endpoint in the new policy or rollback the rollout in region.

samir: Cost note — if we bypass inspection and route audit traffic via public NAT for 1 hour to let onboarding proceed, NAT egress spend estimate ~ $450/hr for eu-west-1 under current qps. Cheaper than losing 120 GPUs for an hour of warm-up failures.

lina: Temporary allowlist sounds reasonable. Quick mitigation plan: 1) add an exception for `auditshipper.redwood.internal:443` to the region fw-policy (ephemeral allow), 2) resume warm-pool join, 3) run full canary of 20 nodes, 4) revert exception after stable.

ashwin: I'll open the rollback/allowlist PR and tag infra. Also adding a short-term policy on ephemeral IAM grants to reduce KMS churn while we stabilize.

ashwin: PR link (draft): https://redwood.internal/infra/pulls/1234 — includes ipset rule + runbook reference.

sre-oncall: Oncall taking. I'll reroute pending provisioning to other regions to reduce user impact and monitor capacity metrics. Setting alert: gpu.warmup.join_rate < 0.6 for 15m.

maria: Also flagging compliance: we'll need to include the temporary exception in the audit log and attach a justification for the security board. Please add to the runbook: `runbooks/gpu-provision-fw-exception`.

samir: Actionable checklist for PR:
• add ipset entry + comment with ticket
• document cost/time window
• add smoke test script (curl auditshipper endpoint) and expected response
• add post-mortem owner

ashwin: Doing the PR now. Tagging @infra and @security for review. If we fail the canary, plan B is full rollback of v2.3 in eu-west-1.

lina: Once PR merges I'll kick the canary and watch `provisioning.join_latency` and `keystore.kms_error_rate` (if that spikes revert). Keep messages in this thread so we have the timeline.

ashwin: Thanks — will post updates. Running quick cost calc and will add to PR description. :thumbsup:
